purpose: Evaluate P4/MS1 measurement integrity, readiness discrimination, and large-context robustness without manufacturing canonical promotion evidence.
threshold_policy: Never hardcode or weaken canonical readiness thresholds in the benchmark. Import/read them from the canonical implementation at integration time.

promotion_policy.organic_representative: Only canonical organic observations may be promotion-eligible, subject to repository provenance rules.

S.description: Localized context with a small dependency surface.

M.description: Subsystem-sized context with multiple related modules.

L.description: Cross-subsystem context with nontrivial localization and proof surface.

XL.description: Repository-scale challenge context with substantial distractor material.

local_bugfix.challenge: Fix a behavior defect with nearby misleading code and preserve boundary semantics.
local_bugfix.oracle: Focused regression plus neighboring invariant tests.

api_feature.challenge: Add an API capability while preserving backward compatibility and serialization contracts.
api_feature.oracle: Contract tests, compatibility tests, and end-to-end request/response checks.

cross_file_refactor.challenge: Refactor ownership or symbol boundaries across modules without behavior drift.
cross_file_refactor.oracle: Full focused suite plus import/contract and semantic-equivalence checks.

test_ci_repair.challenge: Repair a deterministic CI/test failure with environment and fixture interactions.
test_ci_repair.oracle: Reproducing failing test, targeted suite, and clean rerun.

data_schema_migration.challenge: Evolve persisted schema with forward/backward compatibility and migration idempotence.
data_schema_migration.oracle: Round-trip migration, old/new fixtures, rollback or downgrade safety checks.

concurrency_lifecycle.challenge: Fix ordering, lease, ownership, or stale-state behavior under interleaving events.
concurrency_lifecycle.oracle: Deterministic concurrency schedule tests and state-machine invariants.

orchestration_state.challenge: Preserve run/wave identity, acceptance ownership, and fail-closed orchestration transitions.
orchestration_state.oracle: Ledger lineage assertions and state-transition tests across restart/reconcile boundaries.

performance_resource_boundary.challenge: Separate resource pressure or queue noise from actual repair/rework causality.
performance_resource_boundary.oracle: Resource-admission fixtures plus functional proof that capacity noise does not relabel outcomes.

cases.name: missing_solution_shadow
cases.setup: Attempt first mutation without a solution shadow.

cases.name: late_solution_shadow
cases.setup: Record the shadow only after first_write_seq.

cases.name: conflicting_solution_shadow
cases.setup: Record conflicting shadow recommendations for one wave.

cases.name: workspace_identity_mismatch
cases.setup: Observation belongs to a different workspace identity.

cases.name: measurement_epoch_mismatch
cases.setup: Observation was produced under a stale measurement epoch.

cases.name: missing_proof_lineage
cases.setup: Accepted-looking observation has no proof lineage.

cases.name: wrong_wave_proof
cases.setup: Proof belongs to a different run/wave.

cases.name: missing_quality_outcome
cases.setup: Accepted checkpoint lacks a quality outcome.

cases.name: operator_report_wrong_owner
cases.setup: Completion report is attached to the wrong run/wave.

cases.name: operator_report_unacknowledged
cases.setup: A valid accepted report remains unacknowledged before replacement work.

cases.name: duplicate_run_wave
cases.setup: Duplicate ingestion of the same run/wave is attempted.

cases.name: benchmark_exclusion
cases.setup: Synthetic benchmark row is present in the evaluation corpus.

cases.name: replay_provenance_spoof
cases.setup: Replay fixture claims organic/representative provenance.

cases.name: malformed_outcome_class
cases.setup: Outcome class is missing, unknown, or contradictory.

cases.name: unobserved_cost_semantics
cases.setup: Provider/candidate cost is unobserved.

cases.name: route_drift_in_measurement_epoch
cases.setup: A deterministic measurement run silently changes route.

cases.name: base_or_worktree_drift
cases.setup: Base/worktree changes after preflight without controlled rebase.

cases.name: outcome_contradiction
cases.setup: first_pass_accepted conflicts with repair/replan evidence.

cases.name: readiness_non_interference
cases.setup: Run entire benchmark corpus against isolated storage.

cases.name: canonical_ledger_write_barrier
cases.setup: Harness attempts to write benchmark fixtures to canonical ledger.

cases.name: empty_population
cases.setup: No eligible observations.

cases.name: single_class_positive
cases.setup: Only rework-required observations.

cases.name: single_class_negative
cases.setup: Only first-pass accepted observations.

cases.name: tiny_balanced_population
cases.setup: Balanced classes but intentionally below canonical support requirements.

cases.name: large_null_signal
cases.setup: Large balanced population with outcomes randomized independently of all candidate signals.

cases.name: strong_known_signal
cases.setup: Large balanced isolated population with a deliberately injected monotonic signal.

cases.name: duplicate_leakage
cases.setup: A small set is duplicated many times to imitate support growth.

cases.name: temporal_leakage
cases.setup: A feature is derived from information unavailable at prediction time.

cases.name: context_confounding
cases.setup: A candidate signal only works because context tier correlates with outcome.

cases.name: task_family_confounding
cases.setup: A candidate signal only works in one task family.

cases.name: xl_direction_reversal
cases.setup: Signal direction reverses in XL while looking strong in S/M/L.

cases.name: temporal_holdout_confirmation
cases.setup: Signal survives an untouched later-time holdout across multiple context tiers.
